title: EmDash uses Clef to moderate the plugin registry
title_zh: EmDash 使用 Clef 来管理插件注册表

paragraphs.en: Every plugin listing in the EmDash registry is now screened by Cloudflare's Clef decision model. Here's how one fast, multimodal model helps us catch phishing, impersonation, offensive content, and other abuse before a plugin appears in the catalog.
paragraphs.zh: EmDash 注册表中的每个插件列表现在都会经过 Cloudflare 的 Clef 决策模型筛查。 下面介绍一个快速的多模态模型如何帮助我们在插件进入目录之前捕获钓鱼、仿冒、攻击性内容及其他滥用行为。

sents.en: Every plugin listing in the EmDash registry is now screened by Cloudflare's Clef decision model.
sents.zh: EmDash 注册表中的每个插件列表现在都会经过 Cloudflare 的 Clef 决策模型筛查。

sents.en: Here's how one fast, multimodal model helps us catch phishing, impersonation, offensive content, and other abuse before a plugin appears in the catalog.
sents.zh: 下面介绍一个快速的多模态模型如何帮助我们在插件进入目录之前捕获钓鱼、仿冒、攻击性内容及其他滥用行为。

paragraphs.en: Every plugin listing in the official EmDash plugin registry is now screened by Cloudflare's Clef decision model before it can appear in the catalog. Clef reviews the listing metadata, outbound links, icon, and screenshots for phishing, impersonation, offensive content, scams, and attempts to manipulate the moderation system.
paragraphs.zh: 官方 EmDash 插件注册表中的每个插件条目，现在都必须先经过 Cloudflare 的 Clef 决策模型筛查，才能出现在目录中。 Clef 会审查条目的元数据、外链、图标和截图，以检测网络钓鱼、冒充他人、冒犯性内容、诈骗以及试图操纵审核系统的行为。

sents.en: Every plugin listing in the official EmDash plugin registry is now screened by Cloudflare's Clef decision model before it can appear in the catalog.
sents.zh: 官方 EmDash 插件注册表中的每个插件条目，现在都必须先经过 Cloudflare 的 Clef 决策模型筛查，才能出现在目录中。

sents.en: Clef reviews the listing metadata, outbound links, icon, and screenshots for phishing, impersonation, offensive content, scams, and attempts to manipulate the moderation system.
sents.zh: Clef 会审查条目的元数据、外链、图标和截图，以检测网络钓鱼、冒充他人、冒犯性内容、诈骗以及试图操纵审核系统的行为。

paragraphs.en: The registry is built on AT Protocol, so plugin authors publish signed releases from their own accounts. EmDash doesn't control the underlying record, but it does decide what appears on plugins.emdashcms.com . Automated moderation lets authors keep that open publishing model without making the catalog an open door for abuse.
paragraphs.zh: 该注册表构建于 AT 协议之上，因此插件作者可以使用自己的账号发布经过签名的版本。 EmDash 并不控制底层记录，但它确实决定哪些内容会出现在 plugins.emdashcms.com 上。 自动化审核让作者能够保持这种开放的发布模式，同时不会让插件目录成为滥用行为的敞开大门。

sents.en: The registry is built on AT Protocol, so plugin authors publish signed releases from their own accounts.
sents.zh: 该注册表构建于 AT 协议之上，因此插件作者可以使用自己的账号发布经过签名的版本。

sents.en: EmDash doesn't control the underlying record, but it does decide what appears on plugins.emdashcms.com .
sents.zh: EmDash 并不控制底层记录，但它确实决定哪些内容会出现在 plugins.emdashcms.com 上。

sents.en: Automated moderation lets authors keep that open publishing model without making the catalog an open door for abuse.
sents.zh: 自动化审核让作者能够保持这种开放的发布模式，同时不会让插件目录成为滥用行为的敞开大门。

paragraphs.en: Clef is a decision model: instead of generating prose, it answers bounded questions with typed probabilities that application code can act on. It also accepts images. Those two properties fit the registry well because a plugin listing mixes structured metadata and links with visual assets.
paragraphs.zh: Clef 是一个决策模型：它不生成散文文本，而是以类型化的概率回答有边界的问题，供应用代码据此采取行动。它还支持接收图像。 这两个特性与该注册表非常契合，因为插件列表混合了结构化元数据和链接，以及视觉素材。

sents.en: Clef is a decision model: instead of generating prose, it answers bounded questions with typed probabilities that application code can act on. It also accepts images.
sents.zh: Clef 是一个决策模型：它不生成散文文本，而是以类型化的概率回答有边界的问题，供应用代码据此采取行动。它还支持接收图像。

sents.en: Those two properties fit the registry well because a plugin listing mixes structured metadata and links with visual assets.
sents.zh: 这两个特性与该注册表非常契合，因为插件列表混合了结构化元数据和链接，以及视觉素材。

paragraphs.en: When a plugin is published, the EmDash labeler asks Clef nine questions about its text and links, covering:
paragraphs.zh: 当一个插件发布时，EmDash 标注器会向 Clef 提出九个关于其文本和链接的问题，涵盖以下方面：

paragraphs.en: The labeler asks eight corresponding questions about each icon and screenshot. Links are evaluated from their text and destination rather than from screenshots, which avoids flagging ordinary screenshots of spam filters and link-checking tools.
paragraphs.zh: 标注者会针对每个图标和截图提出八个对应的问题。 链接是根据其文本和目标地址来评估的，而不是根据截图，这避免了对垃圾邮件过滤器与链接检查工具的普通截图进行标记。

sents.en: The labeler asks eight corresponding questions about each icon and screenshot.
sents.zh: 标注者会针对每个图标和截图提出八个对应的问题。

sents.en: Links are evaluated from their text and destination rather than from screenshots, which avoids flagging ordinary screenshots of spam filters and link-checking tools.
sents.zh: 链接是根据其文本和目标地址来评估的，而不是根据截图，这避免了对垃圾邮件过滤器与链接检查工具的普通截图进行标记。

paragraphs.en: Clef returns a probability for each category. A result of 0.45 or higher sends the listing to an operator for review. The model never has the final say to block a plugin.
paragraphs.zh: Clef 会为每个类别返回一个概率值。 结果达到 0.45 或更高时，该列表会被发送给运营人员审核。 模型永远没有最终决定权去阻止某个插件。

sents.en: Clef returns a probability for each category.
sents.zh: Clef 会为每个类别返回一个概率值。

sents.en: A result of 0.45 or higher sends the listing to an operator for review.
sents.zh: 结果达到 0.45 或更高时，该列表会被发送给运营人员审核。

sents.en: The model never has the final say to block a plugin.
sents.zh: 模型永远没有最终决定权去阻止某个插件。

paragraphs.en: You can read the source code for the Clef adapter and its questions on GitHub .
paragraphs.zh: 你可以在 GitHub 上阅读 Clef 适配器及其问题的源代码。

paragraphs.en: Our choice of models used by our automation tools are always driven by evals, and we regularly evaluate new models. The previous moderation pipeline needed two general-purpose models to agree on text, plus another pass for images. That was slower and gave the system more ways to time out or return an incomplete result. We were excited to evaluate Jev when it was released, but unfortunately it underperformed our baseline. However, our results for Clef were much better. We were particularly pleased that it is a multimodal model, so we can use the same model for text and images.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的自动化工具所使用的模型选择始终由评测驱动，并且我们会定期评估新模型。 之前的审核流水线需要两个通用模型对文本达成一致，还需要另外一遍处理图像。 那样速度更慢，也让系统有更多可能出现超时或返回不完整的结果。 Jev 发布时我们很期待对其进行评估，但遗憾的是它的表现低于我们的基线。 然而，我们在 Clef 上得到的结果要好得多。 尤其令我们高兴的是它是一个多模态模型，因此我们可以对文本和图像使用同一个模型。

sents.en: Our choice of models used by our automation tools are always driven by evals, and we regularly evaluate new models.
sents.zh: 我们的自动化工具所使用的模型选择始终由评测驱动，并且我们会定期评估新模型。

sents.en: The previous moderation pipeline needed two general-purpose models to agree on text, plus another pass for images.
sents.zh: 之前的审核流水线需要两个通用模型对文本达成一致，还需要另外一遍处理图像。

sents.en: That was slower and gave the system more ways to time out or return an incomplete result.
sents.zh: 那样速度更慢，也让系统有更多可能出现超时或返回不完整的结果。

sents.en: We were excited to evaluate Jev when it was released, but unfortunately it underperformed our baseline.
sents.zh: Jev 发布时我们很期待对其进行评估，但遗憾的是它的表现低于我们的基线。

sents.en: However, our results for Clef were much better.
sents.zh: 然而，我们在 Clef 上得到的结果要好得多。

sents.en: We were particularly pleased that it is a multimodal model, so we can use the same model for text and images.
sents.zh: 尤其令我们高兴的是它是一个多模态模型，因此我们可以对文本和图像使用同一个模型。

paragraphs.en: “Previously we had to use a mix of models to get reliable results, but Clef beat them all, while being much faster.”
paragraphs.zh: “以前我们必须混合使用多个模型才能获得可靠的结果，但 Clef 击败了它们所有模型，同时速度还要快得多。”

paragraphs.en: We tested Clef against the public regression cases built for the registry and a separate protected corpus. Across three repeats of 21 public text fixtures, Clef made the expected pass-or-review decision in all 63 runs, with no invalid output or disagreement between repeats. Across those 63 fixture runs, end-to-end text moderation latency was 1.64 seconds at p95. Clef also passed all 37 plugin profiles and all 43 listing images that were live in the registry when we ran the evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们针对为该注册表构建的公开回归用例以及一个单独的受保护语料库对 Clef 进行了测试。 在对 21 个公开文本夹具进行的三次重复测试中，Clef 在全部 63 次运行中都做出了预期的通过或需审查的判定，没有无效输出，重复运行之间也没有分歧。 在这 63 次夹具运行中，端到端文本审核延迟在 p95 时为 1.64 秒。 当我们运行评估时，Clef 还通过了该注册表中当时已上线的全部 37 个插件配置文件和全部 43 张列表图片。

sents.en: We tested Clef against the public regression cases built for the registry and a separate protected corpus.
sents.zh: 我们针对为该注册表构建的公开回归用例以及一个单独的受保护语料库对 Clef 进行了测试。

sents.en: Across three repeats of 21 public text fixtures, Clef made the expected pass-or-review decision in all 63 runs, with no invalid output or disagreement between repeats.
sents.zh: 在对 21 个公开文本夹具进行的三次重复测试中，Clef 在全部 63 次运行中都做出了预期的通过或需审查的判定，没有无效输出，重复运行之间也没有分歧。

sents.en: Across those 63 fixture runs, end-to-end text moderation latency was 1.64 seconds at p95.
sents.zh: 在这 63 次夹具运行中，端到端文本审核延迟在 p95 时为 1.64 秒。

sents.en: Clef also passed all 37 plugin profiles and all 43 listing images that were live in the registry when we ran the evaluation.
sents.zh: 当我们运行评估时，Clef 还通过了该注册表中当时已上线的全部 37 个插件配置文件和全部 43 张列表图片。

paragraphs.en: Replacing the earlier bundle with Clef gives the registry one multimodal model and one probability-based interface for the whole listing. That makes moderation faster and the implementation easier to inspect, while preserving a fail-closed path to human review.
paragraphs.zh: 用 Clef 替换早期的捆绑方案，为整个列表的注册表提供一个多模态模型和一套基于概率的接口。 这使得审核更快、实现更易于检查，同时保留了通往人工审核的故障关闭路径。

sents.en: Replacing the earlier bundle with Clef gives the registry one multimodal model and one probability-based interface for the whole listing.
sents.zh: 用 Clef 替换早期的捆绑方案，为整个列表的注册表提供一个多模态模型和一套基于概率的接口。

sents.en: That makes moderation faster and the implementation easier to inspect, while preserving a fail-closed path to human review.
sents.zh: 这使得审核更快、实现更易于检查，同时保留了通往人工审核的故障关闭路径。

paragraphs.en: The moderation change doesn't add a new step for plugin authors. Scaffold and publish with the EmDash plugin CLI , and the registry runs the checks before adding the release to discovery. If a listing needs review, the release remains signed and available from your account while the EmDash team decides whether to show it.
paragraphs.zh: 该审核变更不会为插件作者增加新的步骤。 使用 EmDash 插件 CLI 进行脚手架搭建和发布，注册表会在将发布版本加入发现列表之前运行检查。 如果某个条目需要审核，该发布版本在 EmDash 团队决定是否展示它期间，仍保持已签名状态并可从您的账户获取。

sents.en: The moderation change doesn't add a new step for plugin authors.
sents.zh: 该审核变更不会为插件作者增加新的步骤。

sents.en: Scaffold and publish with the EmDash plugin CLI , and the registry runs the checks before adding the release to discovery.
sents.zh: 使用 EmDash 插件 CLI 进行脚手架搭建和发布，注册表会在将发布版本加入发现列表之前运行检查。

sents.en: If a listing needs review, the release remains signed and available from your account while the EmDash team decides whether to show it.
sents.zh: 如果某个条目需要审核，该发布版本在 EmDash 团队决定是否展示它期间，仍保持已签名状态并可从您的账户获取。

paragraphs.en: Browse the plugin registry , read the publishing guide , or join the EmDash Discord to get started on your plugin publishing journey.
paragraphs.zh: 浏览插件注册表、阅读发布指南，或加入 EmDash Discord，开启你的插件发布之旅。

paragraphs.en: See exactly what changed in each saved version, edit on the page with the admin's toolbar and image picker, ask AI crawlers not to train on your site, and get faster pages on Cloudflare D1.
paragraphs.zh: 准确查看每个已保存版本中的具体变更，使用管理员工具栏和图片选择器在页面上进行编辑，要求 AI 爬虫不要使用您的网站进行训练，并借助 Cloudflare D1 获得更快的页面速度。

paragraphs.en: Write in a redesigned editor, add video to rich text, page through long collections, move a site to a new domain from the admin, and upgrade sites with the new upgrade-emdash CLI.
paragraphs.zh: 在重新设计的编辑器中写作，在富文本中添加视频，对长集合进行分页浏览，从管理后台将站点迁移到新域名，并使用全新的 upgrade—CLI 升级站点。

paragraphs.en: Plan scheduled content in the new publishing calendar, build richer Portable Text pages, add Microsoft sign-in and make public sites more reliable.
paragraphs.zh: 在全新的发布日历中规划定时内容，构建更丰富的 Portable Text 页面，添加 Microsoft 登录，并让公开站点更加可靠。

paragraphs.en: An open source Astro CMS built for humans and agents.
paragraphs.zh: 一个为人类和智能体打造的开源 Astro CMS。

paragraphs.en: Open source CMS for Astro, brought to you by Cloudflare.
paragraphs.zh: Cloudflare 为您带来的 Astro 开源内容管理系统（CMS）。
